title: Smart Data Models - UNTP - Product
description: https://test.uncefact.org/vocabulary/Product . The ProductInformation class encapsulates detailed information regarding a specific product, including its identification details, manufacturer, and other pertinent details. Published standalone in the UNTP specification (artefacts/schema/v0.8.0/dpp/Product.json) independent of any specific credential wrapper; also used as the credentialSubject of a DigitalProductPassport (see the DigitalProductPassport model's `product` Relationship).

characteristics.description: Property. A set of industry specific product information.

@context.description: Optional JSON-LD scoped context used to declare vocabulary prefixes for extension properties. Most commonly a single-entry object that binds a prefix to an industry or vendor namespace (for example { "battery": "https://example-industry.org/battery/v1/" }), allowing extension keys in this characteristics object to be written as "battery:batteryChemistry" and expanded to IRIs in that namespace. When omitted, extension keys default to the UNTP characteristics namespace defined in the UNTP JSON-LD context.

mediaType.description: The media type of the target resource.

linkType.description: The type of the target resource - drawn from a controlled vocabulary

evidence.description: A URI pointing to the evidence supporting the claim. SHOULD be a URL to a UNTP Digital Conformity Credential (DCC)

items.description: The UNTP standard classification scheme for conformity topic.  see http://vocabulary.uncefact.org/ConformityTopic

id.description: The unique identifier for this conformity topic

name.description: The human readable name for this conformity topic.

definition.description: The rich definition of this conformity topic.

conformityTopic.description: The conformity topic category for this assessment

performanceClaim.description: Property. A list of performance claims (eg emissions intensity) for this product.
